claimChecks.summary: Authenticated discovery and connection loading pass, but the Browser cannot observe the expected unauthenticated MCP 401 because the public MCP response has no CORS headers.

The bounded fixture was created then revoked without redemption; database readback proves zero credentials and an unconsumed pairing. The full redeem/verify lifecycle could not continue while MCP readiness was false.
Viewport reset, exactly-once Browser finalize, bounded raw method window, durable create/revoke events, runtime health, WorkMesh readback, and zero credential residue pass.

finding.title: Public MCP endpoint omits exact Browser-origin CORS
finding.evidence: GET and OPTIONS http://127.0.0.1:3301/mcp from Origin http://127.0.0.1:3300 return 401 without Access-Control-Allow-Origin or Vary. The active page consequently reports MCP unavailable.
finding.impact: The required Human create/redeem/verify/revoke journey cannot reach the redeem step even though all seven runtime health checks pass.

minimumRepair: Add exact configured Browser-origin CORS to the MCP HTTP server without changing MCP authentication or authorization.
Independently verify focused tests, wrong-origin failure, and active runtime invariance.
Prepare and independently Gate an MCP-only activation/rollback contract.
After an exact Human service-replacement approval, activate only the MCP role and authorize one fresh Browser acceptance attempt.
